name: Write lighthearted school rugby stories about muddy matches
description: Users requested the creation of lighthearted, classic school-story style narratives set in girls' boarding schools or similar institutions, primarily focusing on rugby matches and the players' enjoyment of getting muddy. The prompts frequently specified detailed descriptions of the physical mess, specific stylistic voices reminiscent of mid-20th-century authors, and supplementary elements such as illustration prompts or character dialogues.
